Description: Core AWS platform with isolated source builds and a pinned trusted runner. Onboarding starts no builds.

ref.has: Onboarding, cost gates, permissions, and local validation

must: Create only after human review of ongoing AWS storage and deployment costs.
Use unique prefix per organization/environment; do not reuse across tenants.
One account and region per platform; cross-account artifacts unsupported.

Prefix.Description: Unique resource prefix for this organization/platform, at most 16 characters.

CoreRuntimeRoleArn.Description: Existing Core ECS task role ARN, not its task execution role.

CoreRuntimeRoleName.Description: Exact RoleName corresponding to CoreRuntimeRoleArn, used only to attach scoped STS permission.

AttachCoreRuntimePermission.Description: Attach the scoped AssumeRole policy to the existing Core runtime role.

CoreExternalId.Description: Deployment-specific random external ID; an identifier, not a credential.

CodeConnectionArn.Description: AVAILABLE GitHub CodeConnections ARN in this account and region.

RunnerCommit.Description: Reviewed immutable Core commit. Inline buildspec verifies this commit before executing runner.

RunnerBranch.Description: Approved branch containing the pinned trusted runner commit.

ApplicationRepositories.Description: Exact approved owner/repository IDs. Connection installation must cover these and trusted Core.

ApplicationBranches.Description: Branches permitted when the connection provider supplies branch context. Core also restricts branch selection.

DefaultApplicationRepository.Description: Default secondary source; must be in the approved repository list.

EnableFargateRecipe.Description: Provision the separately scoped fixed container recipe execution role.

FrontendAppId.Description: Optional owner-verified Amplify app ID for one exact frontend publish binding; empty disables it.

FrontendBranch.Description: Exact owner-approved branch for the optional frontend publish binding.

GameStudioModelArns.Description: Optional exact Bedrock model/profile ARNs for Game Studio only; empty grants no model authority. No wildcards.

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: Store build ZIPs, backend code, and deployment receipts privately.
must: Never expose source archives publicly.
Retain deployment evidence and code on stack deletion.

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: Deny insecure transport without opening access.
must: Keep deny on bucket and objects.

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: Separate trusted deployment logs from untrusted application build logs.
must: Do not log tokens or source environment secrets.

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: Separate trusted deployment logs from untrusted application build logs.
must: Do not log tokens or source environment secrets.

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: Bound app runtime permissions, including conditional transaction checks, to platform namespaces.
must: CloudFormation must require this boundary on every new app role.
No IAM, STS, deployments, or account administration.
Container execution permissions stay inside named platform image, secret and log namespaces; runtime inline policies select exact app resources.
Paid Game Studio models require explicit exact model/profile ARNs; the default boundary grants none.

Properties.Description: NCE application Lambda maximum permissions; each app adds a narrower inline policy.

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: Provision only named and tagged NCE recipe resources, passing bounded app roles only to Lambda.
must: No general IAM administration, role boundary removal, or arbitrary pass-role.
HTTP APIs use QuickCreate, never broad untagged child-resource permissions.

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: Application install/build commands are untrusted; isolate them from deployment credentials.
must: No CloudFormation, Lambda, SSM, IAM pass-role, or Amplify permissions.
Source role only writes source archives under builds/.

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: Only pinned Core runner may provision and publish; never execute application code here.
must: Fixed inline buildspec verifies Core Git commit before Python execution.
App source is data; builder executes it under a distinct role.
Migration task definitions and roles stay in the platform namespace; migration command is fixed by the pinned recipe.

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: Core receives short-lived control credentials; store only role identifiers in settings.
must: Trust exactly the existing Core runtime IAM role and deployment-specific external ID.
Core cannot modify IAM or CloudFormation directly.

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: Complete the two-sided assume-role grant on the existing Core runtime role.
must: Grant only this new control role and matching external ID.
Attach to task role, never task execution role or account root.

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: Manual, short-lived CodeBuild runs; no webhooks or always-on compute.
must: Pin trusted primary source and disable buildspec overrides.
No secrets in plaintext environment variables.

BuildSpec.Fn::Sub:
version: 0.2
phases:
  install:
    runtime-versions:
      python: 3.12
    commands:
      - "test $(git rev-parse HEAD) = ${RunnerCommit}"
      - "python3 -m pip install --requirement deployment/cloud-runner-requirements.txt"
  build:
    commands:
      - "python3 -I deployment/aws-apps/runner.py"

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: Manual, short-lived CodeBuild runs; no webhooks or always-on compute.
must: Pin trusted primary source and disable buildspec overrides.
No secrets in plaintext environment variables.

BuildSpec.Fn::Sub:
version: 0.2
phases:
  install:
    runtime-versions:
      python: 3.12
      nodejs: 22
    commands:
      - "test $(git rev-parse HEAD) = ${RunnerCommit}"
      - "python3 -m pip install --requirement deployment/cloud-runner-requirements.txt"
  build:
    commands:
      - "python3 -I deployment/aws-apps/build_source.py"

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: Container provisioning is separate from the existing serverless execution role; only pinned Core templates can use it.
must: Use platform-tagged network resources and named container/database resources.
New task and execution roles require the platform boundary.
No managed-policy attachment, boundary removal or application-code execution.
Application roles cannot invoke network or DNS control operations.
Private namespace support is separate; Cloud Map FAS zone lifecycle only, no record mutation.

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: Fixed provider metadata reads lack ARN support.
must: Exact Fargate role; same region; read only.

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: Cloud Map FAS zone lifecycle; separate policy preserves inline limits.
must: Only Cloud Map FAS; no direct zone operations.
Only fixed Fargate CloudFormation role.
No record mutations or public namespace creation.

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: Task definition deregistration has no IAM resource ARN support.
must: Only exact action in this region and fixed Fargate CloudFormation role.
Fixed runner templates select lifecycle operations; no family ARN restriction is asserted.
Verify app/branch ownership and platform/application tags.
RunnerRole only; disabled by default; no source-selected binding.
Only two publish actions; exact branch and descendants; same account/region.
